# Host profile schema

Report written by pinka-preflight to /etc/pinka/host-profile.json (pokus-infrastructure BUILD_PROMPT §2). generated_at is the only volatile field. Schema file: `preflight/schema/host-profile.schema.json` (JSON Schema draft 2020-12).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this schema. |
| `generated_at` | string | yes | Report time, UTC ISO 8601. |
| `preflight_version` | string | yes | Version of pinka-preflight. |
| `repo_commit` | string or null | yes | Commit of the pokus-infrastructure checkout that ran preflight, if known. |
| `outcome` | one of `supported`, `degraded`, `unsupported`, `needs_action` | yes | Decision (BUILD_PROMPT §2.4). |
| `exit_code` | one of `0`, `10`, `20`, `30` | yes | Exit code that belongs to the outcome. |
| `tier` | see `tier` | yes | Worst of the OS, architecture and environment tiers. |
| `os_tier` | see `tier` | yes | Tier of the matched OS rule. |
| `arch_tier` | see `tier` | yes | Tier of the matched architecture rule. |
| `release_model` | one of `fixed`, `fast`, `rolling`, `null` | yes | Release model of the distribution. |
| `family` | one of `debian`, `redhat`, `suse`, `archlinux`, `null` | yes | Implementation family. |
| `pkg_manager` | one of `apt`, `dnf`, `zypper`, `pacman`, `null` | yes | Package manager of the family. |
| `provider` | one of `baremetal`, `wsl2`, `vm`, `null` | yes | Provider role that applies to this host. |
| `os` | object | yes | Operating system identity from os-release. |

| `access.host` | one of `dedicated`, `shared` | yes | dedicated: no listener besides sshd and the admitted ones, and every login account is a configured researcher; shared otherwise. |

| `access.listeners[].unit` | string or null | yes | The process's systemd unit, or the socket unit of a socket systemd holds. |
| `access.listeners[].admitted` | boolean | yes | pinka's strict input policy accepts this traffic anyway on every interface (the DHCP and DHCPv6 clients, Tailscale's WireGuard port). |
| `access.accounts` | array | yes | The login accounts that are not pinka's: a UID in the login range of /etc/login.defs and a login shell. |
